name: kernelpai
description: KernelPAI — local multi-AI development console (orchestration kernel)

scripts.bench: pnpm build && node scripts/bench-phase0.mjs && node scripts/bench-router.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm build && pnpm test:coverage
scripts.demo:phase3: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @kernelpai/studio build && node scripts/demo-phase3.mjs
scripts.e2e: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @kernelpai/studio build && pnpm --filter @kernelpai/studio-e2e e2e
